schema.text: How are you experiencing this place? (Select all that apply)

options.text: In a wheelchair or mobility scooter
With a pushchair or a shopping trolley
With a walker or a walking stick, or walking with difficulty
With a visual impairment (white cane, guide dog)
Waiting for or using public transport

en.#How are you experiencing this place? (S: How are you experiencing this place? (Select all that apply)
en.#In a wheelchair or mobility scooter: In a wheelchair or mobility scooter
en.#With a pushchair or a shopping trolley: With a pushchair or a shopping trolley
en.#With a walker or a walking stick, or wa: With a walker or a walking stick, or walking with difficulty
en.#With a visual impairment (white cane, g: With a visual impairment (white cane, guide dog)
en.#Waiting for or using public transport: Waiting for or using public transport

it.#How are you experiencing this place? (S: Come vivi questo luogo? (Puoi sceglierne più di uno)
it.#In a wheelchair or mobility scooter: In sedia a rotelle o con scooter elettrico per la mobilità
it.#With a pushchair or a shopping trolley: Con passeggino o carrello della spesa
it.#With a walker or a walking stick, or wa: Con deambulatore o bastone per camminare, o camminando con difficoltà
it.#With a visual impairment (white cane, g: Con disabilità visiva (bastone bianco, cane guida)
it.#Waiting for or using public transport: Aspettando o usando i mezzi pubblici

fr.#How are you experiencing this place? (S: Comment vivez-vous cet endroit ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#In a wheelchair or mobility scooter: En fauteuil roulant ou scooter de mobilité
fr.#With a pushchair or a shopping trolley: Avec une poussette ou un chariot de courses
fr.#With a walker or a walking stick, or wa: Avec un déambulateur ou une canne de marche, ou en marchant avec difficulté
fr.#With a visual impairment (white cane, g: Avec une déficience visuelle (canne blanche, chien guide)
fr.#By bike or e-scooter: À vélo ou en trottinette électrique
fr.#Waiting for or using public transport: En attendant ou en utilisant les transports en commun

de.#How are you experiencing this place? (S: Wie erleben Sie diesen Ort? (Alle zutreffenden Antworten auswählen)
de.#With a walker or a walking stick, or wa: Mit Rollator oder Gehstock oder mühsam gehend
de.#Waiting for or using public transport: Beim Warten auf oder Nutzen von öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln

tr.#How are you experiencing this place? (S: Bu yeri nasıl deneyimliyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#In a wheelchair or mobility scooter: Tekerlekli sandalye veya akülü engelli aracıyla
tr.#With a walker or a walking stick, or wa: Yürüteç veya yürüme bastonu ile ya da güçlükle yürüyerek

fa.#How are you experiencing this place? (S: این مکان را چگونه تجربه می‌کنید؟ (همه موارد مناسب را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#In a wheelchair or mobility scooter: با ویلچر یا اسکوتر برقی معلولان
fa.#With a walker or a walking stick, or wa: با واکر یا عصای راه‌رفتن، یا با دشواری در راه رفتن
fa.#With a visual impairment (white cane, g: با آسیب بینایی (عصای سفید، سگ راهنما)
fa.#Waiting for or using public transport: در انتظار یا هنگام استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی

hu.#How are you experiencing this place? (S: Hogyan éli meg ezt a helyet? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#With a walker or a walking stick, or wa: Járókerettel vagy sétabottal, vagy nehezen járva

ar.#How are you experiencing this place? (S: كيف تختبر هذا المكان؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#In a wheelchair or mobility scooter: بكرسي متحرك أو سكوتر كهربائي لذوي الإعاقة
ar.#With a pushchair or a shopping trolley: مع عربة أطفال أو عربة تسوّق
ar.#With a walker or a walking stick, or wa: باستخدام مشّاية أو عصا للمشي، أو المشي بصعوبة
ar.#With a visual impairment (white cane, g: مع إعاقة بصرية (عصا بيضاء، كلب مرشد)
ar.#Waiting for or using public transport: أثناء انتظار النقل العام أو استخدامه
